question: Which of the following cities were among the safest for women according to (National Annual Report & Index on Women’s Safety) NARI 2025?
solution:
p>The correct answer is __**Kohima, Visakhapatnam, Bhubaneswar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Annual Report & Index on Women’s Safety (NARI) 2025** is a significant analytical tool used to gauge the safety landscape for women in major Indian urban centers. According to the report, **Kohima**, **Visakhapatnam**, and **Bhubaneswar** have been identified as the safest cities for women.
 
• The index evaluates cities based on various performance indicators, including the **Crime Rate against Women**, the effectiveness of **Police Patrolling**, and the availability of **Safe Public Transport**.
 
• **Kohima**, located in **Nagaland**, secured a top position due to its low incidence of reported violent crimes and high levels of community-based security. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
